notes: OVR ratings for 2012-2019 are era-adjusted (rescaled) to match the 2020+ best-of-5 format scale: adjusted = ((raw - mean_2012_2019) / stdev_2012_2019) * stdev_2020_2025 + mean_2020_2025, computed with all classes pooled within each era (since the classification count also changed, 4 classes in 2012-2019 vs 5 in 2020-2025, so same-numbered classes aren't directly comparable across the boundary). 2020-2025 OVR ratings are unchanged from source. OFF and DEF ratings/ranks are NOT era-adjusted (shown as raw source values) - no adjustment methodology has been established for those metrics. All 2012-2019 team-seasons now have non-null off_rating/def_rating values (this was not true in the prior version of this file, which had them as null for 2012-2019 due to incomplete source data at the time). ovr_rank_alltime / off_rank_alltime / def_rank_alltime = rank across all classes and all 14 seasons combined. *_rank_class_alltime = rank within the same classification, pooled across all seasons that used that classification. Two 2025 team-seasons (Sumner, Roosevelt) have no classification/district in the source data; their class-pooled rank fields are null accordingly.
